_note: Assumed brand profile for this concept project, paraphrased from H&M's public positioning (trend-led fashion and quality at accessible prices, with a stated sustainability commitment). Not supplied by or affiliated with H&M.
positioning: Trend-led fashion at accessible prices, with versatile pieces and a sustainability commitment.

inventoryEconomics._note: Assumed unit economics for the newsvendor model, as shares of the selling price. Markdown recovery is what an unsold unit is worth after the season: evergreen pieces can be carried over; pieces tied to a fading trend must be cleared deeply. Trend shock sigma is the season-wide uncertainty about where a trend actually lands.

coreValues: one trend-forward detail rather than many
avoid: more than one statement detail per piece
price points above the band for the category
